title: Update API configuration profiles
author: olearycrew
lessons: CI passing does not mean docs are complete -- Markdoc build validates syntax, not asset references
Empty PR bodies are a yellow flag for premature or draft PRs
Internal link anchors break silently when docs pages are reorganized
Progress tracking with checkmarks in mapping plans gives good at-a-glance status
